answer: Vouching can carry a price that climbs with each recruit. Any established key may sponsor newcomers, and the keys it sponsors form its grove; admitting the n-th member makes the sponsor lock 25×n² POA, slashable in full. One recruit costs 25, ten cost 9,625 together, a grove of 1,000 about 8.3 billion, while the lagoon of rewards pays near 0.4M POA an epoch. Each epoch a falcon audit hands one random grove member a private task; if its reply matches a sibling's above 0.9 similarity, the whole grove's stake burns. Limitation: honest mentors of many newcomers pay the same curve.
